images.label: Detective Pikachu — promotional Charizard render (secondary host)
images.note: Movie promotional image hosted by Pokemon Blog, not an official-hosted TV frame. Fine surface/wing translucency reference; crocodilian face and muted brown colors should not drive identity.

images.label: Jamaal Raoof — Realistic Charizard 2
images.note: Inspected contrast reference, NOT preferred identity target: neck and muzzle elongated, reduced arms and spikes drift toward generic dragon despite teal wings and orange body.

images.label: José Julio García Casado — Charizard 3D study
images.note: Artist credited by La tecnocreativa. Familiar color blocking and head shape; material realism modest, torso is slimmer than original. Secondary anatomy comparison.

images.label: RJ Palmer — alternate Detective Pikachu concept
images.note: Inspected: fuller silhouette, teal membranes, cream belly and orange horns remain recognizable. Dense scales and wrinkled neck lean more reptilian than anime; material comparison only. Primary portfolio image, not a TV frame.

images.label: RJ Palmer — final Detective Pikachu concept (primary full resolution)
images.note: Strongest inspected material guide: recognizable rounded torso, teal wing membranes, orange horns and short angular muzzle. Keep selected anime authoritative for expression; concept adds wrinkles and some animal anatomy.
